mentions.name: jpeg2000
mentions.description: A JPEG 2000 image decoder written in Rust. It implements the format's discrete wavelet transforms and fills the gap of no existing Rust implementation of JPEG 2000; the builder undertook it to learn wavelet transforms and to use Rust in a non-trivial capacity.
mentions.problem: JPEG 2000 did not have a Rust implementation.
